title: Implement necking bar mesh generator with geometric imperfection
objective: Add a rectangular bar mesh generator with geometric imperfection at the midplane for necking localization, using quarter-model symmetry.

plan_assets.asset_description: Necking bar mesh geometry and imperfection specification

scope: Add generate_necking_bar_mesh(nx, ny, nz, L, W, imperfection=0.005) -> HexMesh
Geometric imperfection: smooth taper reducing cross-section at z=L/2
Boundary tags: z0 (symmetry), z1 (prescribed disp), x0 (symmetry), y0 (symmetry)
implementation_steps: Implement generate_necking_bar_mesh with structured mesh generation
Apply smooth imperfection taper at z=L/2 (reduce x and y extents)
Tag boundaries for symmetry BCs and prescribed displacement
acceptance_criteria: Imperfection reduces cross-section at midplane by specified fraction
Boundary tags correctly identify symmetry and loading faces

cases: Verify imperfection reduces cross-section at z=L/2

risks: Imperfection taper may create degenerate elements if taper zone is too narrow relative to element size
Coordinate warping must preserve positive Jacobian determinants
completion_notes: Cosine-bell imperfection taper, boundary tags detected pre-warp, exported from solver/__init__.py
